assertion.text: Erdős Problem #463: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Is there a function $f$ with $f(n)\to \infty$ as $n\to \infty$ such that, for all large $n$, there is a composite number $m$ such that\[n+f(n)<m<n+p(m)?\](Here $p(m)$ is the least prime factor of $m$.) Prize: no. Tags: number theory, primes.
